## Notes

Sam moved to Portland three years ago after a long stretch living in Chicago and still misses the lake in summer. Most weekday mornings start with a run along the river before work, followed by a quick breakfast at the corner bakery. The team at Northwind ships a release every second Thursday, so those afternoons are usually busy and best kept free of other plans. Sam has been learning to bake sourdough bread and keeps a notebook of every loaf, noting hydration, flour blend and how long the dough proofed. Weekends are for the farmers market, long phone calls with family and the occasional trip to the coast.
